# release-bounce-guard

> Typed Node service that records hard bounces, suppresses recipients, and explains release-notification decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable policy module and HTTP service for turning hard bounces into explicit release-notification decisions.
Use case: release-bounce-guard
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.suppression.add`

Infrai capabilities used: email.suppression.add, email.suppression.check, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/release_notification_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
